previous_assumption: docs/marketplace-core-loop-design.md §6 documented awardQuotation as always the Rental Company's unilateral action (quotation.manage-gated) for all three paths, with no Renter action required — treated as a locked, deliberate decision not to touch.
correction: User flagged this live (Award button only ever appeared on the Rental Company's own dashboard, never the Renter's, even with zero negotiation) as the same self-dealing shape as the already-fixed auction "award to self" bug, and asked for it to be fixed the same way. Added commercial_quotations.renter_accepted_at (nullable timestamptz, migration 0018) plus a new Renter-only acceptQuotation action (quotation.respond). awardQuotation now requires renter_accepted_at to be set whenever a real in-app renterOrganizationId exists AND sourceAuctionId is null. Two deliberate exemptions: (1) an external client (clientSnapshot, no renterOrganizationId) has no user account to click Accept — unchanged; (2) a Path C (sourceAuctionId) quotation is exempt because the Renter's earlier auction selectParticipant call already is that explicit consent — requiring a second Accept would be pure friction. Any subsequent term change (updateTerms or applyAcceptedOffer) clears renter_accepted_at back to null, so a stale acceptance can never cover new terms. Does NOT add a new CommercialQuotationStatus value — acceptance is deliberately orthogonal to `status`, preserving the original "no separate accepted status" reasoning in §6 while still closing the gap.
